evidence.title: devl.dev — UI experiments built on coss-ui

name: devl.dev
summary: 158 browsable UI design experiments — app shells, dashboards, auth pages, tables, charts — built on coss-ui, each with copy-paste source.
description: A personal scratch pad of 158 design experiments in 18 folders: layouts and app shells, forms, auth and onboarding screens, dashboards, tables, filters, empty states, settings, cards, modals, charts, timelines, calendars, profile pages and toasts. Everything is built on coss-ui (Tailwind v4 + Base UI); press c on any design to copy its source, or ⌘K to jump around.
